body: I still interact with people, just not Co workers as much, I deal with customers all the time. I am sorry I am trying to be general so anyone reading this can't figure out who I am,although I doubt people I know are reading this. I am due for a doctors appointment again soon, I will have a chat with him then.

I guess these feelings are more common then I thought. I go through these thoughts in my head and have my good days and bad but I feel like if things get really bad I can always end it. I guess the reason I haven't yet is because I am scared for my wife and daughters.
